remarks: Welcome to Park Tower, Stamford's premier luxury residence. This stunning corner unit provides the ultimate in contemporary elegance, just steps from the picturesque Mill River Park and the vibrant attractions of Downtown Stamford. Enjoy unparalleled convenience with a shuttle service to Stamford Train Station, making your commute to New York City effortless. Savor breathtaking sunset views and dynamic park events from your private balcony. The unit boasts a bright and airy open-concept layout with floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flood the space. The sophisticated design includes high-end appliances and both spacious bedrooms feature their own en suite bathrooms, providing privacy and comfort. Indulge in top-tier amenities, roof top terrace with sweeping views of Long Island Sound and Manhattan Skyline, heated saltwater pool, fully equipped fitness center, club house, billiards room and 24/7 concierge service, ensuring every need is met with exceptional care. Discover the perfect blend of luxury and convenience at Park Tower, where every detail is designed to elevate your living experience.
